notes: Master level: 196 postgraduate programmes recorded (distinct name and university). The portal lists 212 entries in all: 157 postgraduate programmes grouped by 2030 Agenda area (People 45, Prosperity 41, Planet 38, Peace and institutions 21, Partnerships 3, cross-cutting 9) and 55 entries under institutional programmes and other schemes. Of these, 204 are postgraduate programmes; 8 entries were left out because they are research or teaching stays, a doctoral call or a postdoctoral stay (not majors), and 8 entries repeat the same name and university under another programme number (for example Análisis Económico Moderno at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos, the URJC biodiversity master, Gobernanza at Universitat Pompeu Fabra and Historia del Arte at Universidad de Salamanca) and are listed once.

Programme names are in Spanish as the portal gives them, including the sponsor in brackets where the portal shows one. Entries not named as a master (for example Escuela Complutense de Verano courses, Experto courses and some Formación Permanente courses) are in the master level list and marked in the detail, because the call treats them as postgraduate awards.
The portal marks every programme "Plazo Cerrado" at the check date: the 2026-2027 application window has closed. The list is for the 26th call (2026-2027).
Doctorate and short postdoctoral stays are separate calls on the same portal (Doctorado 2026, Estancias Cortas Postdoctorales 2026) and carry no programme list.
The earlier note on this page of 204 postgraduate entries and 203 programmes differs slightly from the portal count above; the portal listing was read in full for this pass.
not_stated: Per-programme duration, number of awards and funding terms were read only for the two sheets of the first pass; they are not repeated here.
fetch_problems: The individual programme sheets (one per entry) were not opened in this pass; only the portal list with name and university was read.
